title: Emerywood's Tomato Basil Blue Cheese Soup
description: A rich and creamy tomato soup with fresh basil and tangy blue cheese, inspired by the classic served at Emerywood.

steps.instruction: Warm the stock in a large saucepan over medium heat.
In a separate pan, melt butter over medium heat and whisk in flour to form a roux. Cook until lightly browned and nutty.
Whisk the roux into the warm stock until smooth.
Add tomato paste and whisk until fully incorporated.
Stir in heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add most of the blue cheese (reserving some for garnish) and stir until melted.
Chop or chiffonade the basil and stir into the soup.
Serve hot, garnished with remaining blue cheese and basil.
